question.text: Under Section 15A of the SEBI Act, what is the minimum penalty for failure to furnish any document, return, or report to SEBI?

answer.text: Not less than five lakh rupees
Not less than one lakh rupees
Not less than ten lakh rupees
Not less than fifty thousand rupees

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 15A of the SEBI Act prescribes a minimum penalty of not less than one lakh rupees for failure to furnish documents, returns, or reports to SEBI. The penalty may extend to one lakh rupees for each day during which the failure continues, subject to a maximum of one crore rupees. The Trap: The one lakh rupee figure is the floor of the penalty, not a separate per-day minimum. The per-day component is "may extend to one lakh rupees for each day," capped at one crore rupees overall -- it is not a one lakh per day minimum. Note: Five lakh rupees is the minimum penalty under Section 15HA (fraudulent and unfair trade practices), not Section 15A. Keep the Section 15A wording aligned with the workbook to avoid confusing the two regimes.
